newsitem.title: CHINA: Mineral finds boost China exploration confidence.
newsitem.headline: Mineral finds boost China exploration confidence.

text.p: Recent mineral discoveries have boosted the confidence of China's Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources in finding large reserves of copper, silver and gold in southwest regions, the China Daily said on Friday.
The minerals ministry had made notable progress in exploration in 1997, finding 74 new mineral deposits, the newspaper quoted Vice Minister Zhang Hongren as saying.

"The discoveries strengthened the ministry's confidence in the likelihood of finding 2.5 million tonnes of copper reserves, 5,000 tonnes of silver reserves and 50 tonnes of gold reserves in southwestern China during the next five years," Zhang said.
Recent discoveries included sites in southwestern Yunnan and Sichuan provinces and in the remote Himalayan region of Tibet, China Daily quoted him as saying, but gave no further details.
